_meta.purpose: Source-of-truth square pool for Bingo Mode Phase 1. Move to SteamScraper/bingo_proto/phase1/squares.json at Stage 1 start.

schema.name: Square text shown on the tile
schema.mods_required: Array of mod names. Empty = vanilla. Modded squares are excluded unless lobby toggles 'allow_modded'.
schema.verification: 'honor' | 'duel' | 'dice'. v1 includes honor and dice in the sampling pool; duel is parked for Phase 2.
schema.chapter: Only on level_completion entries — display label from CHAPTERS in rush_data.py.
schema.stat_code: Only on level_completion entries — Steam leaderboard stat code from rush_data.LEVELS.
schema.medal_tier: Only on medals entries — 'dev' | 'emerald' | 'amethyst' | 'sapphire'. Topaz/BD are mean-only.
schema.medal_kind: Only on medals entries — "per_level" | "aggregated". Per-level entries are further gated by Settings.perLevelMedalTiers.
schema.rush: Optional boolean. True = chapter-rush completion square (Violet/Red/Yellow × Heaven/Hell). Gated by Settings.allowRushes.

_meta.lobby_filtering: Lobby settings pick which sections to draw from. Board = uniform random sample from union, filtered by allow_modded and verification in ('honor', 'dice') for v1.
review_needed: mods_required tags in the modded section are best-effort. Worth a manual pass before Stage 1 — especially the EventTracker / NeonLite / SecretShop assignments which I inferred from square text rather than known mod docs.
Square 'Kill any non-balloon demon without the use of a card during the level' — original list had no count. Left as worded; consider whether it should specify N levels.

Square 'Complete any level with a comically small window size' — pure honor, no real verification path. Fine for v1, but worth flagging in the README so testers don't argue about what 'comically small' means.
Squares 'Take a vacation to Idiot Island' and 'Let Red get away' — assumed honor. If they actually depend on a mod, retag.

The Phase 1 chapter-without-discarding squares cover chapters 1,2,3,5,6,7,8,9. Chapters 4, 10, 11, 12 are intentionally absent in the user's list. Did not invent entries for them; can add later if desired.
